readout_other: LFP in hippocampal CA3 and M1 (power, phase-amplitude coupling, cross-correlation); H&E staining
direction_notes: TUS of the hippocampus reduced theta-band amplitude and power, phase-amplitude coupling and hippocampus-M1 correlation of LFPs in penicillin-induced epileptic mice.
safety_notes: H&E staining indicated TUS caused no damage to brain tissue (Supplementary Figure 1).

timing.protocol_description: Fundamental frequency 1 MHz, PRF 500 Hz, duty cycle 50%, pulse duration 1 ms, inter-stimulus interval 1 ms, total stimulation duration 15 min, 0.33 MPa, applied 40 min after penicillin injection. Sham: power amplifier turned off.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Mice were randomized into the TUS group and the sham group, with 10 mice in each group.
